records.applicability: undici 6.29.0 is bundled inside the pinned scanner, npm 11.21.1, which is installed from dependency-audit/scanner with scripts disabled and run only as npm audit. Its only requirer in the bundle is node_modules/node-gyp/lib/download.js (node-gyp 12.4.0, header downloads for native builds), which npm audit does not invoke; npm's registry requests go through npm-registry-fetch and make-fetch-happen. Measured 2026-10-24 (Node 20.20.0, the same load probe and controls): the scanner's exact audit argv, against the application graph and against its own graph, resolved no file under node_modules/undici and returned complete reports. A scanner that crashed would leave the audit incomplete, which fails closed.
records.reason: As of 2026-10-24 no npm release for Node 20 bundles a fixed undici: 11.21.1 is the latest 11.x and bundles 6.29.0 (fixed in 6.29.1, published 2026-10-15), and npm 12.x requires Node 22. Without a disposition the scanner graph is blocking. The accepted residual risk is that the scanner loads undici on a path the measured runs did not take. Remove this record in the same change that moves the scanner to an npm that bundles undici 6.29.1 or later; it expires at 00:00 UTC on 2026-11-30 and is not extended automatically.

records.applicability: undici 6.29.0 is bundled inside the pinned scanner, npm 11.21.1, which is installed from dependency-audit/scanner with scripts disabled and run only as npm audit. Its only requirer in the bundle is node_modules/node-gyp/lib/download.js (node-gyp 12.4.0, header downloads for native builds), which npm audit does not invoke; npm's registry requests go through npm-registry-fetch and make-fetch-happen. The advisory's mechanism is TLS options given to an undici Agent being dropped, so certificate validation does not apply as configured; it needs undici to be loaded and to open a TLS connection. Measured 2026-10-28 on Node 20.20.0, the major CI uses, with a preload that records every module file resolved through Module._resolveFilename and, for ESM, a module.register resolve hook (Node 20 has no module.registerHooks): the scanner's exact audit argv, cwd and scrubbed environment, against the application graph this change installs and against its own graph, resolved no file under node_modules/undici and returned complete reports. Positive controls under the same probe (requiring node-gyp/lib/download.js; requiring undici from the bundle, importing it, and requiring it in a worker thread and in a child process) each recorded 95 undici files. A scanner that crashed would leave the audit incomplete, which fails closed.
records.reason: As of 2026-10-28 no npm release for Node 20 bundles a fixed undici: 11.21.1 is the latest 11.x and bundles 6.29.0 (fixed in 6.29.1, published 2026-10-15), and npm 12.x requires Node 22 (12.2.1, the latest release, bundles 6.29.0 too). The audit dates GHSA-2m5v-pch6-74hx reportable from 2026-10-27, so the inherited finding is deferred only until 2026-11-03; from 00:00 UTC on that day, without a disposition, the scanner graph blocks validation, certification and promotion. The accepted residual risk is that the scanner loads undici on a path the measured runs did not take. Remove this record in the same change that moves the scanner to an npm that bundles undici 6.29.1 or later; it expires at 00:00 UTC on 2026-11-30, with the scanner's GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c record and Frontend's matching records, and is not extended automatically.
